title: Vacuum gripper unit comprising vacuum pump

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
features.note: The reference describes a main body and mounting containers, but not a specific hollow grip portion for manual gripping.

features.item: An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.quote: A vacuum pump is inserted into the first mounting container, while the vacuum pump or a release valve is selectively mounted in the second mounting container.
features.note: The reference discloses a vacuum pump in the housing, but does not specify that it is electrically operated. It mentions 'compressed air' as the operating medium.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe a hollow grip portion through which exhaust air is guided.

features.item: A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference mentions a silencer as a finishing material for the mounting container, but not a sound-damping device in a grip portion.

features.item: A suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to the carrier plate extending around it
features.quote: the suction pad 13 includes a bellows-type lip holder 31 coupled to a lower end portion of the main body 11 , and a skirt-like lip 32 coupled to a lower portion of the lip holder 31
features.note: The reference describes a suction pad with a lip holder and a lip, which functions as a seal, but it does not explicitly mention a 'carrier plate' as a distinct component of the suction plate.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip
features.note: The reference does not disclose a grip unit with all these specific features, particularly a hollow grip portion for exhaust air and a sound-damping device within it, nor an electrically operated vacuum generator.

features.item: Vacuum handling apparatus with suction plate and grip unit combined
features.quote: The present invention relates to a vacuum gripper unit. The unit has a first mounting container and a second mounting container of cylindrical shapes
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripper unit which includes a main body, mounting containers for a vacuum pump, and a suction pad, thus combining a vacuum source and a suction interface.
features.refuted: The quote describes a vacuum gripper unit with mounting containers but does not mention a 'suction plate' or confirm the combination of suction plate and grip unit as asserted.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip portion, nor any lining of such a portion with sound-damping material.

features.item: Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.quote: the first mounting container ( 12 a ) has the vacuum pump ( 16 ) inserted and mounted therein
features.note: The vacuum pump, which is the vacuum generating device, is inserted and mounted within the first mounting container, which can be considered a housing portion.

features.item: Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
features.quote: It is more preferable that the finishing material 25 of the first mounting container 12 a is a hollow silencer.
features.note: The reference explicitly states that the finishing material in the first mounting container (housing portion) is a silencer, which is a sound-reducing device.

features.item: Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip portion that is elongated between housing portions with an air outlet on a second housing portion.

features.item: Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not disclose an air collection screw or similar mechanism upstream of a grip portion for collecting exhaust air.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe bent or curved air baffles downstream of a grip portion.

features.item: Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not mention a battery coupling point or air baffles directing exhaust air away from it.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.quote: the suction pad 13 includes a bellows-type lip holder 31 coupled to a lower end portion of the main body 11 , and a skirt-like lip 32 coupled to a lower portion of the lip holder 31 in an integrated
features.note: The reference describes the lip and lip holder being coupled in a removable manner, but it does not explicitly state that the entire suction pad (suction plate) is releasably connected to the main body (grip unit) via a coupling device.

features.item: Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.quote: a suction pad ( 13 ) connected to a lower portion of the main body ( 11 ) so as to communicate with the common vacuum chamber ( 14 )
features.note: The main body acts as part of the grip unit, and it is fluidically connected to the suction pad (suction plate) via the common vacuum chamber.
features.refuted: The quote mentions a suction pad connected to communicate with a common vacuum chamber, but does not mention a 'suction opening' or 'suction chamber delimited by suction plate' as asserted.

claims.note: The reference describes a vacuum gripper unit, but not specifically for a hand-operated laying device or for use with a suction plate in that context.

claims.quote: A vacuum gripper unit including a vacuum pump, the vacuum gripper unit comprising: a vertical main body ( 11 ) having a common vacuum chamber ( 14 ) defined therein;
claims.note: The reference discloses a vacuum gripper unit with a main body and a vacuum pump (vacuum generating device), but the vacuum pump is not described as electrically operated, and there is no explicit 'grip portion for gripping the grip unit' in the sense of a handle for manual operation.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.

claims.quote: air present in the vacuum chamber 14 and the suction pad 13 is pulled into the vacuum pump 16 through the passage 15 and the through hole 19 (see arrow {circle around ( 2 )}) and is then discharged through
claims.note: The reference describes exhaust air being discharged by the vacuum pump, but it does not state that this air is guided through a 'grip portion' to an air outlet. The outlet is directly from the vacuum pump.

claims.quote: It is more preferable that the finishing material 25 of the first mounting container 12 a is a hollow silencer.
claims.note: The reference discloses a silencer (sound-damping device) but it is located in a mounting container, not explicitly in a grip portion as required by the claim.
The reference does not disclose the grip portion being lined with a sound-damping material.

claims.quote: wherein the first mounting container has the vacuum pump inserted and mounted therein and operating to allow exhaust of air from the common vacuum chamber
claims.note: The reference discloses a vacuum pump (vacuum generating device) mounted in a first mounting container (first housing portion), but the claim specifies an 'electrically operated' vacuum generating device, which is not taught here.

claims.quote: It is more preferable that the finishing material 25 of the first mounting container 12 a is a hollow silencer.
claims.note: The reference discloses a silencer (sound-reducing device) in the first mounting container (first housing portion), but it does not teach the first housing portion being lined with sound-reducing material.

The reference describes a vacuum gripper unit with a main body and mounting containers, but does not describe a 'grip portion' elongated between housing portions or an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion in the context of the subject claim.
The reference does not disclose an 'air collection device' in the form of an air collection screw, nor does it describe collecting exhaust air upstream of a grip portion.
The reference does not describe 'bent or curved, air baffles' arranged downstream of a grip portion for guiding exhaust air to an air outlet.

The reference does not disclose a 'battery coupling point' for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery on the housing, nor does it mention air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a point.

claims.note: This passage discloses a vacuum gripper unit for gripping objects, which is a type of vacuum handling apparatus.
claims.refuted: The quote describes what the invention relates to, not a component of the apparatus.

claims.note: The reference discloses a suction pad connected to a main body with a vacuum chamber, which can generate a vacuum. However, it does not explicitly mention a 'suction opening' or a 'suction chamber delimited by the suction plate'.

overall.why: The reference describes a vacuum gripper unit with a vacuum pump and suction pad, sharing some functional similarities and components like a silencer and modular design, but it lacks specific features related to a hollow grip portion for exhaust air and an electrically operated vacuum generator.
